videos.title: Sa Re Ga Ma Pa 2026 - October 18, 2026

videos.overview: The contestants celebrate the musical legacy of legendary composers S.D. Burman and R.D. Burman, bringing their timeless melodies to life through performances on the Sa Re Ga Ma Pa stage.

videos.overview: Legendary Punjabi singer Gurdas Mann blesses contestant Sehajdeep, while Minha's inspiring journey brings an emotional and heartfelt moment to the competition.

videos.overview: Love takes center stage as the contestants deliver romantic musical performances, captivating the audience and impressing judge Shankar Mahadevan with their talent.
